description: Eastern Provincial Council - Regulations of Certifying the Safety and Convenience of Passengers, No. 02 of 2017, effective from 01.09.2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new regulations ("Regulations of certifying the safety and convenience of passengers No. 2, 2017") enacted under the Eastern Province Road Passengers Transport Authority Ordinance. It establishes regulatory requirements for driver/conductor uniforms, official identity cards, and electronic ticketing systems. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for passenger transport services.
